formula.description: u16 LE code; bank=(v>>8)&0xFF, low=v&0xFF. bank==0: low<0x80 -> ctrl, low>=0x80 -> half-width glyph tile=2*low-14 (vertical 2-tile stack, 8x16px). bank!=0: if v+33>=NUM_TILES(14336) -> ctrl (out of range, non-printable marker), else -> full-width glyph tile=v (2x2 tile block, 16x16px).
